summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing for Agroplaza after mockData removal & API integration rewrite. 23/23 backend pytest tests pass. All major frontend flows (homepage, category, product, search, shops, login, signup, protected route, merchant dashboard/store/products/xml-feed/billing) load correctly and integrate with the backend.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased on signup; user.email returned differs in case from request body. Minor — but undocumented.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/auth/me is called unconditionally even when no session_token exists, producing a 401 in console on every page render. Consider skipping the call when localStorage.session_token is null and no auth cookie is present.

action_items: (Optional) In AuthContext.jsx, skip authMe() call when no session_token in localStorage and no cookie to remove harmless but noisy 401s in console.
(Optional) Seed sample products for the test merchant so /merchant/products empty-state can be visually verified beyond an empty list.

Reconcile /app/memory/test_credentials.md vs /app/auth_testing.md (the latter shows password 'Test1234!' while credentials.md says 'password'). The seeded merchant hash was previously 'Test1234!'; testing agent updated the seeded merchant password_hash in MongoDB to match the documented 'password'. Main agent should update /app/backend/seed.py (or seeder logic) so re-seeds reproduce 'password' deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/seed.py does NOT create the merchant test account (merchant@test.gr). The seeded merchant account exists in DB but the seed script doesn't reproduce it — re-running seed will not restore it. Add idempotent merchant user upsert in seed.py.
/app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js still present after the rewrite — should be deleted or moved to fixtures since all consumers now use api/client.js.
/app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.jsx hard-codes Google auth URL to 'https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...' which is fine, but the same flow has no error message UI for Google sign-in failure.
client.js: every page hits /api/auth/me even for anonymous visitors, generating 401 noise. Use a guard in AuthContext.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (created — 23 tests covering catalog, search, auth, merchant, billing, tracking)
MongoDB: db.users.password_hash for merchant@test.gr updated to bcrypt('password') to match /app/memory/test_credentials.md
test_credentials: merchant@test.gr / password (verified working). Hash in DB was Test1234! — testing agent reset to 'password' to match credentials doc.
seed_data_creation: Updated merchant@test.gr password hash to 'password' in MongoDB (test_database.users). No other seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py — re-runnable. Greek search, Greeklish ('sporoi' -> σπόροι), and accent-insensitive search all confirmed working at backend level. Merchant flow: login at /login with merchant@test.gr/password redirects to /merchant/dashboard with stats + recharts. Note: /merchant/products list is empty for the test merchant (no products seeded for that store_id); not a bug, just empty data. The 401 console errors on every page are from AuthContext calling /api/auth/me without checking for a token first.
rca_of_the_issue: Auth login failure RCA: test_credentials.md documents 'password' but the seed/legacy hash in MongoDB was bcrypt('Test1234!') — a stale value left over from /app/auth_testing.md. Fix applied: directly updated merchant@test.gr.password_hash via mongosh to bcrypt('password'). Permanent fix: seed.py should idempotently upsert the test merchant user with the documented password.
